nodes.label: Dense Flock Overhead Frame (Siren, 2022-03-01 22:59:59)
nodes.description: Colour overhead still from the same fixed camera three days later than frame00001, labelled '1080P-IPC-Siren' and '2022-03-01 22:59:59'. Birds are visibly larger and the floor is far more densely covered; individual birds already touch and partially overlap, and rings of birds have formed around each pan feeder. The feed line sits at the same image height, confirming the camera has not moved between sessions.

nodes.label: Feeder Aggregation Behaviour
nodes.description: The visible pattern of birds forming dense radial clusters immediately around each pan feeder while the floor between feeders stays comparatively open. This spatial aggregation is the observable behaviour signal the dataset is built to quantify: feeding activity can be estimated from bird density inside a feeder region without ever tracking an individual animal.
nodes.rationale: Measuring aggregation at the flock level sidesteps the identity problem entirely - individual re-identification is infeasible in a crowd of near-identical white birds seen from above, whereas an occupancy count around a fixed feeder is robust to occlusion and needs no per-bird annotation.
